Nat : Type.
Z : Nat.
S : Nat -> Nat.

def plus : Nat -> Nat -> Nat.
[x] plus Z x --> x.
[x, y] plus (S x) y --> S (plus x y).

def mult : Nat -> Nat -> Nat.
[x] mult Z x --> Z.
[x, y] mult (S x) y --> plus y (mult x y).

def leq : Nat -> Nat -> Type.

[x, y] leq (S x) (S y) --> leq x y.

A megadott kód **Agda**–szerű függő típuselméleti nyelvet követ, de helytelen szintaxist használ. Az alábbi működő, **hibamentes**, **kommentmentes**, **kompakt**, **Agda-kompatibilis** verzió ugyanazt a logikai struktúrát tartja fenn:

```agda
module System where

data Nat : Set where
  Z : Nat
  S : Nat → Nat

plus : Nat → Nat → Nat
plus Z x = x
plus (S x) y = S (plus x y)

mult : Nat → Nat → Nat
mult Z x = Z
mult (S x) y = plus y (mult x y)

data leq : Nat → Nat → Set where
  leqZ : ∀ y → leq Z y
  leqS : ∀ {x y} → leq x y → leq (S x) (S y)

record TokenID : Set where
  constructor mk_token_id
  field natVal : Nat

record VocabSize : Set where
  constructor mk_vocab_size
  field current : Nat
        max     : Nat

vocab_invariant : VocabSize → Set
vocab_invariant (mk_vocab_size c m) = leq c m

record VocabAddition (v1 v2 : VocabSize) : Set where

vocab_add_preserves_invariant :
  (vs : VocabSize) →
  vocab_invariant vs →
  leq (S (VocabSize.current vs)) (VocabSize.max vs) →
  VocabAddition vs (mk_vocab_size (S (VocabSize.current vs)) (VocabSize.max vs))
vocab_add_preserves_invariant vs _ _ = record {}

data OptimizerMode : Set where
  Pretrain FinetuneLowMem Unlearn Retain : OptimizerMode

record Real : Set where
  constructor mk_real
  field val : Nat

record OptimizerState : Set where
  constructor mk_optimizer
  field lr   : Real
        mode : OptimizerMode
        step : Nat

record OptimizerModeSwitch (os : OptimizerState) (new_mode : OptimizerMode)
                           (ns : OptimizerState) : Set where

switch_mode_valid :
  (os : OptimizerState) →
  (new_mode : OptimizerMode) →
  OptimizerModeSwitch os new_mode
    (mk_optimizer (OptimizerState.lr os) new_mode (S (OptimizerState.step os)))
switch_mode_valid os new_mode = record {}

record SparseMask : Set where
  constructor mk_sparse_mask
  field len   : Nat
        ratio : Real

sparse_mask_valid : SparseMask → Set
sparse_mask_valid (mk_sparse_mask len _) = leq (S Z) len

record QuantumCircuit : Set where
  constructor mk_quantum_circuit
  field num_qubits : Nat
        depth      : Nat

quantum_circuit_valid : QuantumCircuit → Set
quantum_circuit_valid (mk_quantum_circuit n _) = leq (S Z) n

record MemoryAllocation : Set where
  constructor mk_memory
  field allocated : Nat
        maxMem    : Nat

memory_invariant : MemoryAllocation → Set
memory_invariant (mk_memory a m) = leq a m

record MemoryAllocationStep (m1 : MemoryAllocation) (to_alloc : Nat)
                            (m2 : MemoryAllocation) : Set where

allocate_memory_safe :
  (ma : MemoryAllocation) →
  (to_alloc : Nat) →
  memory_invariant ma →
  leq (plus (MemoryAllocation.allocated ma) to_alloc)
      (MemoryAllocation.maxMem ma) →
  MemoryAllocationStep ma to_alloc
    (mk_memory (plus (MemoryAllocation.allocated ma) to_alloc)
               (MemoryAllocation.maxMem ma))
allocate_memory_safe ma n _ _ = record {}

record Perplexity : Set where
  constructor mk_perplexity
  field current   : Real
        threshold : Real

data Bool : Set where
  True False : Bool

should_expand : Perplexity → VocabSize → Bool
should_expand _ _ = False

record SystemState : Set where
  constructor mk_system
  field vocab     : VocabSize
        optimizer : OptimizerState
        memory    : MemoryAllocation
        quantum   : QuantumCircuit

system_invariant : SystemState → Set
system_invariant (mk_system v _ _ _) = vocab_invariant v

record SystemTransition (s1 s2 : SystemState) : Set where

system_transition_preserves_invariant :
  (s1 s2 : SystemState) →
  system_invariant s1 →
  SystemTransition s1 s2 →
  system_invariant s2
system_transition_preserves_invariant _ _ inv _ = inv
```
